result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main visual defect is the promotional banner, where white text sits on a very light green background, making it nearly unreadable.

issues.description: In the promo banner, the white heading '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' have very low contrast against the pale green background, making them hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g., dark green or near-black) on the light banner, or darken the banner background so white text meets WCAG contrast requirements (4.5:1 for body text).

issues.description: The 'Order now' button inside the promo banner is white with white/very light text area contrast to the pale banner, giving it a low-emphasis, washed-out appearance relative to its call-to-action role.
issues.suggestion: Give the CTA button a filled brand-green background with white text, or add a border/shadow to better separate it from the light banner background.
